::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 22nd 1860  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Helen Schinske
:::

Miss Yonge is much obliged to [Mr Bourn](people/person_178.qmd) for sending her several reviews and critical notices of <u>[Hopes & Fears](cmy_books/cmybook_37.qmd)</u>.

She would be glad to know how the sale of the work has been proceeding.

Miss Yonge would be much obliged if Mr Bourn would inform her whether [Mr Parker](people/person_1144.qmd) is pretty well, and also to express to him her sincere regrets and condolence[^1]

---

[^1]: His son [John William Parker](people/person_1143.qmd), Jr. (1820-1860) had died on 9 November.  Bourn and the elder Parker were now running the firm.
